dossier.summary: Cedarpoint Credit Union serves about 90,000 members across Oregon from 14 branches, and moved its online banking to a new core provider last year.
dossier.why_now: Posted a job for a head of digital lending in September.

data.booth_note: The full loan application flow running end to end on two screens, and a table at the back where we can go through your own numbers without the hall noise.

booth_hours.who: Tom Adebayo until 1:00 pm, then Ingrid Solberg

side_events.title: Credit union lunch
side_events.note: Forty people from credit unions in the Pacific Northwest. No vendors speak, we just sit at the table.

side_events.title: Harbor reception
side_events.note: The whole show is there for the first hour. Tom will be near the east door.

side_events.title: Digital lending roundtable
side_events.note: Twelve seats, by invitation. Two are ours and one of them is yours if you want it.

data.why_now: Posted a job for a head of digital lending in September.
data.personal_line: A new head of digital lending and a core switch in the same year usually means the loan application flow is next on the list. Our stand has that flow running end to end, so twenty minutes there will show you what it would mean for Cedarpoint's members.
